verdict.rationale: Swell's own docs say stores can be localized with multiple content languages, dynamic currency conversion, and local-currency pricing on supported payment gateways. That covers translations and multi-currency directly. Nothing in the pack addresses duties or import taxes, and localized storefronts per market are only implied by the general 'localize your stores' claim. Missing for 10: any evidence of duties/import-tax handling, documentation of per-market localized storefronts (domains, market-specific catalogs), detail on which gateways support local-currency pricing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can sell internationally with localized storefronts, multi-currency pricing, translations, and duties handled

citations.quote: Localize your stores with multiple content languages and dynamic currency conversion, plus pricing in local currencies with supported payment gateways.
